consequence.statement: Installing 0.16.0 can fail with the error "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook".
consequence.remediation: Use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on your installation path.

original.statement: Installing or upgrading to 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook"; upstream says to use 0.16.1 instead, where this is fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-0eb3d16492e3] lists the error "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook" under "Guide to Promoting to 0.16 › Troubleshooting". Its fix is to use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on the installation path. So the 0.16.0 install or upgrade path fails with this error, and the 0.16.1 remediation matches the text. Confidence is low because the text quotes only the error and never says outright that the upgrade fails. The rendered spec.conversion removals (e.g. [ev-7a082965d61c]) are not tied to the error in the evidence.
